The '''Pirate Rug''' is a decorative piece of [[furniture]]. It is obtained by finishing [[Penny]]'s [[Penny#Fourteen Hearts|14-Heart]] event (and choosing the Pirate Theme option).

If the original is lost, a replacement can be purchased at the [[Secret Woods#Lost Items Shop|Lost Items Shop]] in the Secret Woods for {{Price|10000}}.

==Note==
Pirate Rug is one of only four rugs that cannot be purchased via the [[Furniture Catalogue]], [[Joja Furniture Catalogue]], [[Wizard Catalogue]], [[Junimo Catalogue]], or [[Retro Catalogue]]. The other three are [[Fruit Salad Rug]], [[Sandy Rug]], and [[Desert Rug]].
